_comment: Car-seat stroller ADAPTER fragment (batch S9 UPPAbaby). UPPAbaby VISTA LOWER car seat adapter (double mode). Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: UPPAbaby Lower Car Seat Adapter for Vista (Maxi-Cosi/Nuna/Cybex/Clek)
seatBrandsSupported: Maxi-Cosi (Mico NXT, Mico Max Plus), Nuna PIPA series, Cybex Aton series, and Clek Liing & Liingo — Clek Liing explicitly listed. (Not compatible with Maxi-Cosi Prezi.)

install.notes: Mounts an infant car seat in the LOWER position of the Vista chassis for double/tandem use; pairs with the upper adapter (Clek adapter-clek-uppababy / UPPAbaby 0919-UMA-WW) so two car seats or seat+car-seat combos work.

notes: UPPAbaby-made lower adapter used ONLY in Vista double mode (Clek row: 'Lower: 0918-LMA-WW'). All Vista models 2015+ (V2/V3). $49.99, in stock. Fits the Clek Liing among Maxi-Cosi/Nuna/Cybex seats.
